title: Append-only policy version store and destructive migration lint

scope_out: must not expose an update or delete method on the policy_version repository; must not restrict application.status, loan.outstanding_principal or loan.delinquency_bucket, which stay mutable per D5; must not add a destructive statement to any migration to simplify a schema change

entities.name: Append-only policy version store and destructive migration lint

operations.text:
1. Define the `PolicyVersion` read model and `PolicyVersionRepository` in `backend/src/repository/policy/policy_version_repository.py` (new), exposing only `insert(product_code: str, rules: dict[str, object], created_by: UUID) -> PolicyVersion`, `get(policy_version_id: UUID) -> PolicyVersion`, `get_active(product_code: str) -> PolicyVersion`, and `activate(policy_version_id: UUID) -> None` — `activate` writes only the mutable `product.active_policy_version_id` pointer (D-E), never a column on `policy_version` — against the `policy_version` table already registered in `backend/src/repository/models.py` (owned by E1-S1). No method on this class is named `update` or `delete` (AC1).
2. Add migration `backend/migrations/versions/0003_policy_version_constraints.py` (new): additive-only `ALTER TABLE` statements that add `UNIQUE(product_code, version_number)` and the `NOT NULL` constraints on `policy_version` (table created by E1-S1's `0001_identity_catalog_policy.py` tracer migration), and add the FK plus `UNIQUE(active_policy_version_id)` constraint linking `product.active_policy_version_id` to `policy_version.id` per `specs/design/data-models.md`. No `DROP TABLE`, `DROP COLUMN`, or destructive `ALTER` statement appears, so this file is itself compliant with steps 4 (AC4).
3. Add `backend/tests/architecture/test_policy_version_immutability.py` (new): statically scan every file under `backend/src/` and `backend/migrations/` for `UPDATE`/`DELETE` SQL text and ORM mutation calls (`.update(`, `.delete(`, `session.delete(`) targeting `policy_version`, asserting 0 occurrences of each; separately enumerate `PolicyVersionRepository`'s public methods from `backend/src/repository/policy/policy_version_repository.py` and assert none is literally named `update` or `delete` — covering AC1, AC2.
4. Add `backend/tests/architecture/test_migration_lint.py` (new): define a lint function parsing every `.py` file under `backend/migrations/versions/` (schema and policy migrations alike, including `backend/migrations/versions/0003_policy_version_constraints.py`) for `DROP TABLE`, `DROP COLUMN`, and destructive `ALTER` statements, and assert 0 hits across all of them — covering AC3, AC4.
